# Quadratic realizable net error and a finite exact learner
2026-10-29. Addendum to GAP_FREE_ONLINE_THEOREM_v1.md; author derivation, pending review. It improves the net size and supplies an exact finite-arithmetic option. The v1 expected cumulative theorem remains useful; no high-probability or complete large outer-code execution is silently added.

## Quadratic approximation without a source excitation gap
For every current reduced source Kraus K_a, the true twisted swap S_* commutes with K_a. For any candidate S_C,
 delta(C)=(1/(2D))sum_a ||[K_a,S_C]||F²
         =(1/(2D))sum_a ||[K_a,S_C−S_*]||F²
         <=2||S_C−S_*||op² <=(9/2)||C−C_*||F².
Thus replace v1's comparator term3epsilon T by(9/2)epsilon² T. Taking epsilon=T^(-1/4) still gives O(sqrtT) comparator cost, while M=O(T^(3/4)), not O(T^(3/2)). This uses the exact common-algebra promise, not an estimated gap or independently distributed errors.

## One rational quaternion chart suffices for rotations
Represent any rotation by a unit quaternion q with q0>=0, using q and−q equivalence. Its stereographic coordinate u=q_vec/(1+q0) lies in the unit ball. Choose integer grid k in[-m,m]^3 and u=k/m. The inverse chart is exactly rational:
 q0=(m²−|k|²)/(m²+|k|²), q_vec=2m k/(m²+|k|²).
It is unit length exactly. Euclidean quaternion distance is at most2 times the u-distance; nearest grid point gives distance<=sqrt3/m. Rotation Frobenius distance is at most2sqrt2 times quaternion distance, hence <=2sqrt6/m. Choose m>=2sqrt6/epsilon (an integer conservative choice m=ceil(5/epsilon) avoids an irrational threshold). The net has at most M=(2m+1)^3 candidates. Matrix entries are rational with denominators dividing D_k², D_k=m²+|k|²<=4m². Duplication is harmless.

## Exact multiplicative weights, with all arithmetic and sampling charged
The actual swap-loss estimator lies in[-87/4,93/4]. Shift/scale it:

     =[10−yz C_ab(1+9uv C_cd)]/20 in[0,1].
For a probe role of probabilityp, use fhat/p; on a service round use0. Its conditional mean is f(C)=(delta(C)+87/4)/45. The additive baseline cancels in regret. For rational eta<=p/2, update integer/rational weights by

# Gap-free online learning inside a finite guarded operation
2026-10-29. Author composition, independent review pending. Governing dependencies: v1 star-loss transfer, v2 exact rational learner, received physical-permutation CP/memory theorem, and the already constructed arbitrary-error CSS outer code. This adds finite roles/readiness; it does not assert competitive gate complexity or laboratory performance.

## Protocol and exact scope
Fix even n, a fixed K-dimensional singlet subcode, horizon/cap T, desired J service slots, correction radius t and allowed validation failures b. Choose p+a+s=1. Each unfinished round:
1. Draw candidate star rotations from the current independent expert distributions using fresh private coins; set the root frame toI and all other site frames to those rotations.
2. Privately choose LEARN with probabilityp, VALIDATE with probabilitya or SERVICE with probabilitys, independently of the fresh candidate draw.
3. LEARN uses the actual product-probe bank and updates the expert weights. VALIDATE uses a fresh matching-survival test in this candidate frame. SERVICE uses the same candidate frame and the actual private physical-permutation orbit on the next outer-code symbol.
Stop with acceptance after J services if at mostb validation failures; abort at b+1 validation failures, sampler exhaustion or the cap. If the Jth service completes on the last allowed round, acceptance is evaluated before cap exhaustion; exactly T calls are allowed, not T−1. The unknown payload may instead be deferred by the separately received resource-first wrapper.

All three choices use the same physical-source port and pre-call process boundary. No current role, probe setting, matching or group key may leak externally. For the online-learning READINESS proof the source must also not learn the fresh candidate-frame draw before its current channel is fixed. It may know previous frames/records and react to the current quantum input through that fixed map. Merely hiding a role while broadcasting the fresh randomized action is insufficient for the expert-loss argument.

## Soundness outside the collective-family promise
Conditioned on any chosen frame, the physical orbit gives a virtual CP good/bad instrument and p_bad<=C_n q_match, C_n=(n+2)/(n-1). Thus the competing-risk ratio is R=C_n s/a. LEARN calls may alter memory arbitrarily; they do not invalidate this cond
